question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **asked**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the usage of the given words.
 
 
• **"Asks"** is used as a verb in the **Present tense** when referring to **3rd person**. (He/She)
 
• **"Ask"** is a **verb** meaning 'put a question or seek an answer from someone'.
 
• **"Asked"** is the **past and past participle** form of ask.
 
• **"Asking"** is the gerund, which means to call on for an answer.
 
 
 
• In the question** 'one day'** is mentioned and it denotes a **past incident**, so, **"asked"** should be used.

Hence, the correct answer is:** option 3.**

**Complete Paragraph:** *One day, my six-year-old sister (1) **asked__ **us which career she should (2)______ for. My father suggested (3)______ she should become a doctor, (4)______ my mother said she could (5)______ a newspaper reporter. I (6) ______ she would make a (7)______ teacher. After a brief (8)______ my sister declared, “I will become (9)______ actress. Then I will get an (10)______ to play all these roles.”*
